name: Aura Chat Button – Click to Chat and Support for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: Aura Plugin

sections.description:
WooCommerce WhatsApp Chat Button & Support Widget

Add a professional WooCommerce WhatsApp chat button and WhatsApp support widget to your WordPress website. Aura Chat Button is a high-performance WhatsApp click to chat solution designed to boost customer engagement, improve sales conversion, and provide seamless customer support via WhatsApp.

Manage your WhatsApp business hours efficiently with a smart scheduler that ensures you only receive customer chats when your team is available. Experience the most advanced WhatsApp analytics dashboard for WordPress, tracking every WhatsApp button click, chat open, and conversion to optimize your sales funnel.

Why Choose Aura Chat Button?

  • WooCommerce Smart Integration – Pre-configured for WooCommerce Shop Pages, Product Detail Pages, and Checkout.
  • Premium 3D Styles – Professional WhatsApp button designs with glassmorphism and high-end 3D effects.
  • Advanced WhatsApp Analytics – Real-time statistics tracking your WhatsApp click to chat performance.
  • Contextual Customer Support – Automatically shares page title (H1) and URL in the WhatsApp message.
  • WhatsApp Business Hours – Full visibility control based on your working schedule and offline status.
  • Interactive Typewriter Greeting – High-conversion “Support Team is typing…” animation for better engagement.
  • Mobile First Experience – Separate controls for WhatsApp button size and position on mobile devices.

Key Features of our WhatsApp Widget

  • Ultimate WooCommerce Control – Display the chat button on specific WooCommerce pages.
  • 6 Stunning Button Designs – Style 1 through Style 6 premium WhatsApp designs.
  • Dynamic Chat Tracking – Reliable WhatsApp conversion tracking with Chart.js integration.
  • 10 Major Languages – Fully localized WhatsApp widget translated into 10 global languages.
  • Offline Notification System – Customizable messages for customers contacting you outside working hours.
  • Pixel-Perfect UI – Adjust X/Y positions separately for mobile WhatsApp and desktop views.
  • Url Sanitization – Clean URLs to ensure perfect WhatsApp link previews for your products.
  • Custom Avatar Support – Brand your WhatsApp chat with your logo or support agent photo.

10 Languages Supported

  • English (default)
  • German (de_DE) – 🇩🇪
  • Spanish (es_ES) – 🇪🇸
  • French (fr_FR) – 🇫🇷
  • Italian (it_IT) – 🇮🇹
  • Japanese (ja) – 🇯🇵
  • Portuguese (PT-BR) – 🇧🇷
  • Russian (ru_RU) – 🇷🇺
  • Chinese (zh_CN) – 🇨🇳
  • Hindi (hi_IN) – 🇮🇳
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aura-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the ‘Aura Chat Button’ menu from your admin dashboard.
  4. Configure your WhatsApp phone number and customize your chat button style.
  5. Enable WooCommerce integration or Business Hours as needed.
sections.faq:
Is this the best WhatsApp button for WooCommerce?

Absolutely! We offer dedicated controls specifically for WooCommerce stores to maximize customer sales.

Does it track WhatsApp clicks?

Yes, our WhatsApp analytics plugin tracks button clicks, chat openings, and conversion rates.

Can I hide the WhatsApp button on mobile?

Yes, you have full control over mobile visibility for your WhatsApp widget.

Does it support RTL for WhatsApp?

Yes, the design is fully RTL compatible for global multilingual support.
